channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon is now available
item.description: Gemini 4 Carbon, released Nov 10, 2026 for developers, enterprises, scientists and consumers, ranks first on three independent benchmarks including CursorBench 4.0 and has per-task costs over 2x lower than the next-best external model. (Google DeepMind)

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon in GitHub Copilot
item.description: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon, built for complex coding, agentic and reasoning tasks with a focus on secure code generation, is now generally available in GitHub Copilot under usage-based billing at provider list pricing. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Gemini Intelligence: New features, on more devices
item.description: Gemini Intelligence arrives on Pixel 10 and Motorola Signature 27 with Rambler, which turns dictated speech into text in real time, plus custom widgets and task automation expanding to the UK, India and Japan. (Google AI Blog)

item.title: Work at the Frontier: AI’s effect on freelance work
item.description: OpenAI and Upwork report that 38% of U.S. knowledge workers freelance and earned $1.5 trillion in 2024, while 43 of 63 work categories with tasks common in ChatGPT lost share on Upwork, mapping AI’s effect on freelance work. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Codex CLI 0.167.1
item.description: Codex CLI has been bumped to 0.167.1, and the release notes link the full changelog from rust-v0.167.0 to rust-v0.167.1 alongside the GitHub release and the update records for the two prior versions, 0.166.0 and 0.167.0. (OpenAI Codex Changelog)

item.title: Pay for Hugging Face Hub with your Google Cloud Account
item.description: Linking a Hugging Face organization to a Google Cloud account through Google Cloud Marketplace now bills Hugging Face usage on the Google Cloud invoice instead of a credit card, though subscription requires team review and already card-linked organizations switch at the next billing cycle. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: Google Cloud launches Gemini for healthcare.
item.description: Google Cloud’s Gemini for healthcare unifies electronic health records, billing platforms and Medicare datasets while targeting clinicians’ nearly 28-hour weekly documentation burden, with HCA Healthcare among partners previewing record synthesis and prior authorization review workflows. (Google AI Blog)

item.title: C++ language server now auto-configures MSBuild builds
item.description: Microsoft C++ Language Server for GitHub Copilot CLI now bundles its MSBuild compile commands extractor and calls it automatically, so agents skip a separate configuration skill while still getting precise code intelligence for MSBuild projects. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Introducing Businesses in ChatGPT
item.description: OpenAI's beta Businesses in ChatGPT lets companies claim and manage their information via Business Hub, see mention and website-click insights, and—for eligible U.S. ecommerce and online-service businesses—enable Business Agents to reach ChatGPT's 1.2 billion weekly users. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth
item.description: AlphaProof Code agents generated over three million lines of machine-checked Lean proof to verify Signal's core cryptographic protections down to machine instructions in just four weeks, a task that typically takes years. (Google DeepMind)

item.title: Decision Models in Hugging Face
item.description: For a customer support refund case, Hugging Face decision models output probabilities over options directly instead of generating text, and adding a Legal department needs no new classification head, unlike traditional classifiers. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life
item.description: OpenAI Academy's free November 10 workshops in five U.S. cities teach caregivers to use ChatGPT for scheduling and finding resources, as OpenAI's analysis finds 40 million U.S. health messages weekly are asked on someone else's behalf. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Dependabot alerts will pause on inactive repositories
item.description: From December 8, 2026, GitHub will pause Dependabot alerts on most repositories with no activity in the past year, archiving rather than deleting existing alerts, with any push restoring them and resetting the one-year timer. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: We’re bringing Adobe’s creative and productivity tools closer to your everyday Google apps.
item.description: At Adobe MAX, Google and Adobe announced an expanded partnership that lets users edit PDFs directly in Drive and use Adobe AI in Gemini, while Google's frontier AI models head into Adobe apps to reduce app-switching. (Google AI Blog)

item.title: iPhone Duo 开卖两周：DeepSeek、B 站补位，苹果搬出 10 万适配 App 撑场
item.description: Two weeks after iPhone Duo launched, DeepSeek and Bilibili have filled its inner screen while WeChat still shows black bars until iOS 27.1, as Apple cites 100,000 adapted apps to make ecosystem support the upgrade decider. (AIbase)

item.title: Closing the AI guidance gap in education
item.description: OpenAI cites a ThinkYoung survey finding 79% of students use AI for homework while only 47% receive guidance on how to use it, framing the education guidance gap. (OpenAI News)

item.title: A more informative GitHub dashboard
item.description: GitHub's dashboard update makes the layout more compact and scannable after developers complained that generous padding, wrapped titles and a low default item count showed too little, and it no longer displays Agent sessions when none are available. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: 基元律动发布NeoHorse-1.5-Flash Preview，开放限量内测
item.description: TokenRhythm's agent-native NeoHorse-1.5-Flash Preview, trained on Qwen3.8-Flash with 180B total and 6B active parameters, gains over 20 points on physical science tasks and is now in limited beta. (AIbase)

item.title: ByteDance's Seedream 5.5 officially launches on Doubao, bringing a comprehensive upgrade to its image design capabilities
item.description: ByteDance’s Doubao integrated the Seedream 5.5 image model on November 10, enabling up to 100 rounds of continuous edits that leave unmodified areas unchanged and native RGBA transparent assets without cutout work. (AIbase)

item.title: KFC's Japan blunder: AI-generated product images — even the ice cubes came out "dyed
item.description: KFC Japan was reported by ITmedia on November 10 after its AI-generated product image for a trial new drink showed ice cubes tinted the same colour as the soda with a jelly-like sheen, and the brand confirmed using generative AI while declining to say whether it will expand the practice. (AIbase)
